comparison.objective: Meter a hydraulic release valve to lower a fragile cabinet safely; candidate iteratively adjusts a shock absorber to stop a moving carriage safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve fine rotary control informed by dynamics, but cabinet lowering uses continuous valve metering under load; candidate additionally requires recessed-key unlocking, collar adjustment, relocking, and repeated impact trials.
comparison.success_condition: Cabinet lands at controlled speed without glass contact and remains rail-supported for 3 s; candidate requires ≥0.85 J impacts, ≤12 mm stroke, no hard-stop/rebound/overload, and lock stability.
comparison.reason: There is adjacent closed-loop mechanical adjustment, but the candidate uniquely tests retained damper calibration through repeated impacts and witness-torque validation.
